title: Petition under Section 66 and 79 of the Electricity Act, 2003, read with Regulation 15 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions for Recognition and Issuance of Renewable Energy Certificate for Renewable Energy Generation) Regulations, 2010, thereby imploring this Commission for setting aside the communication dated 13.03.2023 issued by Respondent No.1 rejecting the Renewable Energy Certificate for the month of July, 2022 and by relaxing the timeline provided in Regulation 7 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions for Recognition and Issuance of Renewable Energy Certificate for Renewable Energy Generation) Regulations, 2010 and direct the Respondent No.1 to issue REC to the Petitioner corresponding to the generation of power for the month of July, 2022.
